recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, low-angle portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and tactical-style jacket, set against a dark, textured background with high-contrast lighting and gritty, weathered typography overlaid on the right side.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal tilt of the subject's head creates a dynamic tension against the vertical text block.
The warm highlights on the face and hat contrast with the deep shadows and cool-toned jacket.
The distressed texture of the typography mimics the organic, weathered feel of the background elements.
coreInvariants: High-contrast, low-key lighting focused on the face.
A palette dominated by browns, tans, and deep blacks.
A mix of smooth skin tones and rough, industrial textures.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the left two-thirds of the frame, slightly tilted, in a medium close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the brim of the cowboy hat serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the face, follows the tilt of the hat down to the jacket, and then moves right to the large-scale typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space on the far left and top, with a textured, dark bokeh effect on the right behind the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns provide the foundation and shadow depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tans and ochres highlight the hat and skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted metallic gold and silver appear in the jewelry and text textures.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the lit face and the dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit blues and greens to very dark, desaturated tones

letterConstructionRules: Tall, narrow proportions with flat terminals
Visible erosion and grunge textures applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature 'chipped' edges and internal speckling to suggest rusted metal or worn paint.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, textured condensed sans-serif for the name paired with a clean, extended italic sans-serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Radial 'splatter' or 'crack' graphic behind the text to create a focal burst.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed weight and height.
Matches the wide, modern feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a tan cowboy hat and a dark olive-green nylon jacket. Lighting should be dramatic, coming from the top left, leaving the right side of his face in shadow. The background should be dark and moody with abstract, warm-toned bokeh and a subtle radial crack texture on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, condensed sans-serif text on the right side. Apply a rusted metal texture to the text. Below it, add a smaller, extended italic sans-serif word in solid off-white, aligned to the right edge of the main text.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast and moody?
Does the text have a weathered, industrial texture?
Is the subject's head tilted to create a diagonal line?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones and blacks?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Any branded logos on the jacket or jewelry
Unique facial features of the specific individual

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of text and background texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the texture.
Check that the cowboy hat does not look cartoonish.
Verify the radial crack graphic doesn't obscure the subject's face.
Confirm the overall mood is gritty and serious.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait Subject (Cowboy/Rugged) + Low-Key Lighting + Earth Tone Palette + Distressed Condensed Typography = Modern Country Aesthetic
